external_module_preflight.driver_scope: The platform driver binds both phram nodes; it cannot bind only adt. Its probe maps and MTD-registers each resource using the FDT label. Its remove path MTD-unregisters and unmaps. It also exposes erase/write callbacks; the plan below invokes neither.

conditional_build_capture_unload_plan.status: PLAN ONLY: wait for router lifecycle release and a distinct root mutation approval.
conditional_build_capture_unload_plan.taint_limit: An out-of-tree module can add a kernel-taint bit. Its later unload does not promise to restore /proc/sys/kernel/tainted to the pre-load value (currently 4), so only module/MTD restoration is asserted.
commands: set -euo pipefail; umask 077; work=$(mktemp -d /tmp/ane-phram.XXXXXX); capture_dir=$(mktemp -d "$HOME/.cache/ane-live-adt.XXXXXX"); chmod 700 "$capture_dir"; cat /proc/mtd >"$capture_dir/mtd.before"; cat /proc/sys/kernel/tainted >"$capture_dir/tainted.before"; test ! -d /sys/module/phram; test -z "$(for d in /sys/class/mtd/mtd*; do [[ $(basename "$d") =~ ^mtd[0-9]+$ ]] && test "$(cat "$d/name")" = adt && basename "$d"; done)"; sudo -n true

module_attempted=0; restoration_failed=0; cleanup() { rc=$?; trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM; if test "$module_attempted" = 1 && test -d /sys/module/phram; then if ! sudo -n rmmod phram; then restoration_failed=1; printf '%s\n' 'RESTORATION FAILED: phram remains loaded; preserving work and capture artifacts.' >&2; fi; fi; if test -d /sys/module/phram; then restoration_failed=1; fi; cat /proc/mtd >"$capture_dir/mtd.after"; cat /proc/sys/kernel/tainted >"$capture_dir/tainted.after"; if ! cmp "$capture_dir/mtd.before" "$capture_dir/mtd.after"; then restoration_failed=1; fi; if test "$restoration_failed" = 1; then printf '%s\n' "RESTORATION FAILED; artifacts preserved at $work and $capture_dir" >&2; exit 125; fi; rm -rf "$work"; exit "$rc"; }; trap cleanup EXIT HUP INT TERM

curl --fail --silent --show-error --max-time 30 https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AsahiLinux/linux/e2e1930a9595bffafad92cec2b5504525efb9cd4/drivers/mtd/devices/phram.c -o "$work/phram.c"; printf '%s  %s\n' 7f0e2077fd2c6c6d883f9266c1e3065e0b7912e84df5eb9dd84d2483ee2b766b "$work/phram.c" | sha256sum -c -; printf 'obj-m += phram.o\n' >"$work/Makefile"; make -C /usr/lib/modules/$(uname -r)/build M="$work" modules; case "$(modinfo -F vermagic "$work/phram.ko")" in "$(uname -r)"*) ;; *) exit 1;; esac

adt_mtd=$(for d in /sys/class/mtd/mtd*; do [[ $(basename "$d") =~ ^mtd[0-9]+$ ]] && test "$(cat "$d/name")" = adt && test "$(cat "$d/size")" = 507904 && basename "$d"; done); test "$(printf %s "$adt_mtd" | wc -w)" = 1; sudo -n dd if="/dev/$adt_mtd" bs=4096 iflag=fullblock count=124 status=none >"$capture_dir/adt.bin"; test "$(stat -c %s "$capture_dir/adt.bin")" = 507904; chmod 600 "$capture_dir/adt.bin"; sha256sum "$capture_dir/adt.bin" >"$capture_dir/adt.bin.sha256"
sudo -n rmmod phram; module_attempted=0; test ! -d /sys/module/phram; cat /proc/mtd >"$capture_dir/mtd.after.manual"; cmp "$capture_dir/mtd.before" "$capture_dir/mtd.after.manual"
